name: Dubai / United Arab Emirates
study_positioning: Regional study destination for business, technology, hospitality, medical and transnational university campuses.

visa.route: UAE student residence visa sponsored by an accredited university, educational institution, or eligible parent sponsor

fee.name: Student residence visa
fee.note: Fees vary by university, emirate, insurance, medical test, Emirates ID and deposits

process: Secure admission from accredited UAE institution
University or eligible parent acts as sponsor/guarantor
Submit passport, photos, admission/enrolment evidence and other required forms
Complete medical fitness and Emirates ID steps where required
visa.deadlines: Follow the university's admission and visa processing timeline. Start immediately after admission for international students needing sponsorship.
notes: Student residence is typically tied to continuing enrolment.
Outstanding students may qualify for UAE Golden Visa routes.
